body_markdown:
Is your morning drink basically a personality trait at this point? You’re definitely not alone. Over half of Gen Z says their go-to beverage directly* reflects who they are, and let’s be honest, whether you’re holding an iced oat latte or a ceremonial-grade matcha, your drink sets the entire tone for your workday.


This National Coffee Day (September 29), we’re embracing the cafe-to-desk pipeline. We’re launching limited-edition desk gear available across North America, and hosting a three-day activation with West Hollywood staple La La Land Kind Cafe, to celebrate the drinks that fuel your focus.


**The Limited Drop: Pebble 2 and Desk Mat Matcha and Coffee Editions**


- **Matcha** : Calm, sage green tones built for lo-fi beats, intentional planning and mindful focus.


- **Coffee** : Warm, creamy latte neutrals designed for fast-paced study sessions and high energy output.


**The LA Pop-Up: Sip, Shop & Work**


If you’re in Los Angeles, come hang out with Logitech. From September 29 through October 1, we’re taking over the La La Land Kind Cafe on West 3rd Street.


Stop by to grab a custom Logitech drink, test-drive the limited edition Pebble 2 mice at our hands-on remote work stations, take your photos in the photo booth or with the lifesize mouse and level up your work-from-cafe routine.


These coffee and matcha-inspired sets drop exclusively on


[Logitech.com](https://logi.link/f5014a) and Logitech’s TikTok Shop on September 29, available while stock lasts. This gives matcha and coffee lovers, as well as students, digital creators and remote workers, a chance to align their desk accessories directly with their daily beverage choices.


Which side of the desk debate are you claiming when the drop goes live? #TeamCoffee or #TeamMatcha


###### *according to


[National Coffee Association](https://pureearthcoffee.com/blogs/fuel-your-pursuit/gen-z-coffee-consumption-habits-2026?srsltid=AU7gw4U48IJjIXY2vc5eKNw3ktoEHaLMVV2gxhM-r8vqazeDBo1h5B1y)
